import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess
r=subprocess.run(["pdftotext","-layout","output/pdf/bunkbed-transitive-tournaments.pdf","-"],capture_output=True)
t=r.stdout.decode()
pages=t.split("\f")
for i,p in enumerate(pages[:5],1):
    lines=[l for l in p.splitlines() if l.strip()]
    print("="*20,"PAGE",i,"lines",len(lines))
    print("\n".join(lines))
